evidence.quote: All the educational packages from the smallest startup forward They have an added value that is token or chips.

all packages also have the opportunity to double their tokens through the spilt spilt SC barometer, which begins at zero and when it reaches its 100 percent, all the package tokens that you have bought are going to double.

textual.context: The speaker presents this as part of explaining ways to be part of the OneCoin community and how to benefit from packages; no explicit warning or denial is present in the cited source.
textual.potential_relevance: A reward claim of doubled tokens is linked to tokens in packages that the audience has bought and to a stated condition of the barometer reaching 100 percent.
textual.limitations: ASR may contain transcription errors; the records do not establish whether the doubling occurred, what the exact package terms were, or any external verification of OneCoin tokens.

it says 1754. this is a approximate value of your currencies if you bought a pro trader package.

textual.limitations: The ASR does not provide the full visual table or transaction interface, and it does not verify the stated package price, token count, coin conversion, or value.

textual.limitations: The source does not establish the actual package terms, whether the projections were realized, or whether the displayed figures are accurately transcribed.

textual.potential_relevance: A requested action to decide or buy quickly is linked to the claimed benefit of receiving more coins before the difficulty number rises.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the difficulty-number mechanism, the timing of any changes, or whether viewers were directly instructed how to purchase.

textual.limitations: The source does not provide full referral terms, eligibility rules, whether the invited person must buy anything, or confirmation that tokens were awarded.

textual.observation: Presenter forecasts that the coin will be between 50 and 100 euros in two to three years, and possibly 150 euros per coin.

evidence.quote: Remember that this coin is going to be between 50 and 100 euros in your next two to three years and probably, even 150 euros per coin

textual.context: The forecast is stated after examples tying package purchases to coin quantities and projected values; it is not framed as a warning or quotation from another party.

textual.limitations: The records do not verify any market price, future listing, liquidity, or whether the projected price was attainable.

Other sampled slides display changing package prices and return figures.

Another slide states that the packages provide one split per account, while a premium trader package permits mining and obtaining splits.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes paid OneCoin package tiers by linking prices to token allocations, coin conversion, and projected euro values. It applies time pressure by claiming that delaying a purchase reduces the coins received, forecasts substantially higher future coin prices, and offers token rewards for inviting another person. The records do not establish completed transactions, realized returns, or the accuracy of the stated projections, and the ASR may contain transcription errors.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is purchasing packages and tokens tied to conversion into OneCoin and projected appreciation. The video presents package prices, token quantities, coin values, and future price scenarios. Mining is also a supported secondary mechanism because a paid package is connected to tokens being mined and converted into coins.
